Use `noc_fit(y, method = "NOC")` to fit NOC to a finite response vector
`y` in equally spaced design order. Use `noc_fit(y)` to obtain NOC, its
shared empirical Bayes baseline EB0, and its matched comparison RAW.
The fitted values follow the original order of the observations.

The source repository contains the scripts for the manuscript's four
simulation scenarios and the fixed Raman split. Its README explains
the commands and inputs.
